_source: Rules of Play 1.2 (component counts 42 Roman / 46 Seljuk) and 1.9.2. Dual-allegiance Lords (Robert, Roussel, Arisighi) have card sets in both decks; a Lord's cards are usable in the Plan only while he is Mustered on that side (4.1.1). Action cards bear a numeral (Command Rating); No Command and Treachery are special.
_plan_note: Season sets the required Plan stack size (4.1); some Events add cards (Treachery + No Command; Unpredictable Weather Summer -> 9).
